pCloud - Secure Cloud Storage for Your Files

pCloud is the secure place for your photos, videos, and documents - all in one app. Access your files anytime, anywhere, and keep everything safely stored and organized across all your devices.

Back up your memories automatically, free up space on your phone, and enjoy your content on the go. Preview and edit your photos, stream HD videos, and listen to your music without downloading. Easily share large files with anyone, even if they don’t use pCloud.

Start with up to 10 GB of free storage. Optionally, you can expand up to 10 TB of storage with monthly, annual or lifetime plans.

Features:

• Up to 10 GB free storage upon registration
• Store and access photos, videos, and files
• Automatic photo and video backup
• Access your files anytime, anywhere
• Stream videos and music instantly
• Share large files with a link
• Sync across all your devices
• Simple, intuitive and easy to use
• Add zero-knowledge encryption
